verses.translation: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—
even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—
and by every parent and ˹their˺ child
Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle

verses.arabicText: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
verses.translation: Do they think that no one has power over them
boasting, “I have wasted enormous wealth!”
Do they think that no one sees them
Have We not given them two eyes
a tongue, and two lips
and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺
If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺
And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is
It is to free a slave

verses.arabicText: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
verses.transliteration: Aw iṭ'ʿāmun fī yawmin dhī masghabat
verses.translation: or to give food in times of famine
to an orphaned relative
or to a poor person in distress

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
verses.transliteration: Thumma kāna mina alladhīna āmanū watawāṣaw bil-ṣabri watawāṣaw bil-marḥamat
verses.translation: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion
These are the people of the right

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyātinā hum aṣḥābu l-mashamat
verses.translation: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left
The Fire will be sealed over them
